convert_proto_to_struct: create a function that converts an arbitrary protobuf message to its opaque Struct proto representation via JSON
parse_filter_config_proto: parse a filter config proto text file from the filesystem into a known filter config object

summarize_ProtoToStruct: summarize the ProtoToStruct function that serializes a proto to JSON then parses it into a Struct proto
